note: Decisions 80 and 86, and the Thriller and Crime build's decisions 1 and 3: the door holds every film tagged Crime and every film the labels place behind it, and runs on the model labels. One question, its kinds, then "anything". A film labelled behind the door with no kind, or not yet labelled, is reached through "anything" and "Just pick one!". The crime pool claims no stray, so a Crime film Drama or Action holds keeps that door. A kind under 30 films in the library is not offered (prison, in the operator's library).

questions.ask: so what are you in for?

options.say: cops and detectives. somebody has to work the case.
options.reply: coffee's on. it's going to be a long night.

options.say: gangsters, crews, and organized crime. strictly business.
options.reply: of course. I know a guy.

options.say: heists, cons, and one last job.
options.reply: excellent. nobody touches the money until I say so.

options.say: crime, consequences, and the people caught in the wreckage.
options.reply: no clean getaway from this one.

options.say: serial killers. the case, or the killer's side of it.
options.reply: I'll pull the case files. don't read them alone.

options.say: prison. doing time, or breaking out.
options.reply: good. I'll check the bars. you check the exits.
very well. I'll make a few calls.

cops.note: cops and detectives; the law or a detective works the case (The Departed, Knives Out, Fargo).

gangsters.note: gangsters and the mob; organised crime from the inside (The Godfather, GoodFellas, City of God).

heists.note: heists and cons; the plan, the crew, the job, the swindle (Ocean's Eleven, Baby Driver).

crime_drama.note: crime seen as a human story more than a thrill; shared with the drama door's crime dramas.

serial_killers.note: the hunt for, or the mind of, a serial killer; shared with the thriller door, so a film behind both doors holds it at both or neither.

prison.note: prison and escape (The Shawshank Redemption, Escape from Alcatraz). Under the 30-film bar in the operator's library, so hidden there.
